en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 9, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include the Michigan Army National Guard improving trails at Ludington State Park, a visually impaired creator sharing accessible LEGO guides, Columbia University and MTA upgrading the 125th Street subway station, and NCKU Library's exhibition promoting accessible reading.
